provenance_note: The isolated gateway served the Agent Worlds page built into the Kiro Crew checkout (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/agent_worlds, website/src/pages/WorldsPage.tsx) at its /worlds route, because a gateway that still ships the built-in cannot install a second app under the same name. This repository is the externally packaged copy of that page, ported onto the App SDK; PORTING.md lists where the two differ, and none of the differences is on screen in these pictures.
data: fictional: four chat sessions and two scheduled jobs created through Kiro Crew's own session and cron APIs
data_notes: The sessions were created empty with a title and no message, so every character is idle: no agent turn ran, and no model was asked anything.
The two scheduled jobs are enabled but not due during the capture, so they show as idle sprites.
